excerpt: Eclatira is a developer engine for real-time conversational video agents that can talk, see through a camera or shared screen, and take actions through APIs, MCP servers and 3,000+ apps. What it does and alternatives.
content:
Eclatira is a conversational video engine for developers. Instead of wiring together separate systems for voice, video, vision and actions, you connect one engine to your application, and your AI agent can hold a direct voice-to-voice conversation, see in real time through the user's camera or a shared screen, and take actions through your own APIs, MCP servers or more than 3,000 connected apps. Its launch images show an agent commenting on an object held up to a webcam and another reviewing a shop page during a screen share. Customer support agents that can act, not just answer, are one use case raised by commenters.

On Product Hunt, co-founder and CEO Moad Rahali Semlali said the engine supports about 100 languages and roughly 400 accents, is not tied to one language model, and does not store live camera or screen streams. Authentication for the app integrations is handled by a third-party integration provider. Eclatira launched on 26 September 2026 and finished #2 for the day with 287 points and 62 comments.

We have not tested Eclatira ourselves. Its website blocked our automated check, so this page is based on its Product Hunt launch and the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.starts_at: Product Hunt lists free options; see eclatira.com
profile.summary_short: Engine for real-time video agents that talk, see a camera or screen, and take actions

gallery.alt: Eclatira demo of a live video call in which the agent describes an inflatable banana held up to the user's webcam
Eclatira live screen-share session where the agent reads a shop page and answers whether a product pack is a good deal
Eclatira diagram connecting an agent to any MCP server, any API and 3,000+ apps such as Slack, Shopify, Salesforce and HubSpot

fit: are a developer adding a live voice and video agent to your own app
need an agent that can see a user's camera or screen, for example in support or tutoring
want the agent to take actions in other apps without building each integration yourself
not_fit: want a no-code, ready-made chatbot rather than an engine to build with
need published pricing before you try it: we could not read Eclatira's site
need to choose the underlying model today: the founder said model selection is planned, not yet available

pricing.intro: We could not read pricing on eclatira.com as of 14 October 2026 because the site blocked our automated check.
notes: Product Hunt lists it as free options.

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: LiveKit
items.what: Open-source framework and cloud for building voice, video and physical AI agents
items.starts_at: Open source; see its pricing page
items.difference: A lower-level, open-source framework you assemble yourself. Eclatira bundles voice, vision and actions in one engine.

items.name: Daily
items.what: Real-time voice, video and AI for developers, including the open-source Pipecat
items.difference: Video infrastructure plus an agent framework. Eclatira adds ready connections to 3,000+ apps for actions.

items.name: ElevenLabs
items.what: AI voices, text to speech and voice agents
items.starts_at: Free plan; see its pricing page
items.difference: Strong on voice. Eclatira's pitch is combining voice with live vision and actions.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Video SDK and Vapi as alternatives.

quotes.author: Kruti Parekh
quotes.text: How does the product approach privacy when the agent has access to live camera or screen streams?
quotes.reply: Moad Rahali Semlali: live streams are not stored today; any storage option would be off by default.

quotes.author: Dipanshu Kushwaha
quotes.text: Does it support multiple languages for voice interactions?
quotes.reply: Moad Rahali Semlali: yes, 100 languages and about 400 accents.

quotes.author: Jack Hayes
quotes.text: dealing with separate vision and voice models was such a pain.

faq.a: A developer engine for real-time conversational video agents that can talk, see through a camera or shared screen, and act through APIs, MCP servers and 3,000+ apps. It launched on Product Hunt on 26 September 2026.
The CEO said on Product Hunt it supports 100 languages and about 400 accents.

faq.q: Does Eclatira record camera or screen streams?
faq.a: The CEO said live streams are not stored, and any future storage option would be off by default.

faq.q: Which AI model does it use?
faq.a: The CEO said it is model-agnostic and switches between models; letting users choose the model is planned.
Through a third-party integration provider that handles authentication and permissions, according to the CEO.
We could not read Eclatira's pricing; Product Hunt lists it as free options.
